name: car-na-mao
description: CAR na Mão: retificação do Cadastro Ambiental Rural pelo celular (app, API e site).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix apps/mobile ci
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api node dist/database/seed.js
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck
